about.bioParagraph1: Halo! Saya Adya Sena Pamungkas, seorang Frontend Developer lulusan Teknologi Informasi, Universitas Gadjah Mada (UGM).
about.bioParagraph2: Berpengalaman membangun aplikasi web modern dan sistem enterprise menggunakan Laravel, React.js, Next.js, dan Tailwind CSS, dengan ketertarikan mendalam pada interaksi visual, performa Core Web Vitals, dan arsitektur frontend yang bersih.

highlights.title: Modern Web Ecosystem & Enterprise Stack
highlights.desc: Building robust, performant, and scalable web applications using Laravel, React.js, Next.js, Tailwind CSS, and clean API integrations.

highlights.title: UI/UX & Design Systems
highlights.desc: Certified in Figma High-Fidelity & Prototyping. Translating complex wireframes into intuitive, accessible design systems.

highlights.title: Collaborative Problem Solving
highlights.desc: Experienced across hybrid and on-site agile engineering teams, delivering clean, reliable, and user-centric web solutions.

experience.description: Perjalanan profesional dalam merancang dan mengembangkan aplikasi web modern di berbagai industri mulai dari enterprise, startup AI, hingga institusi pendidikan.

items.description: Developing scalable frontend architectures and enterprise web interfaces, ensuring high reliability, maintainability, and optimal user experiences.
Developed and optimized key frontend features for Notulensi, an AI-based meeting note-taking platform, using Next.js, NextUI, and Tailwind CSS.
Engineered an educational web portal documenting Indonesian traditional medicine (jamu), featuring interactive media, recipes, and video guides using Next.js.
Built and styled interactive landing pages for TEDxUGM main event and pre-event campaigns using Next.js and modern CSS.
Coordinated the design division while developing a full-stack MERN web profile for local tourism and MSME enterprises in Kalirejo.
Developed facility tracking frontend applications with React.js and customized the OpenSID open-source village governance portal.

skills.description: Combining modern web development stack and UI/UX design principles to deliver beautiful, responsive, and high-performance digital products.

categories.description: Building fast, dynamic, and scalable modern enterprise web applications.
Crafting modular, responsive, and pixel-perfect interface components.
User experience prototyping and collaborative development workflow.

works.description: Proyek nyata antarmuka web yang pernah saya rancang dan kembangkan di lingkungan startup, institusi, dan komunitas.
